rows.accuracy_limits: No promotion beyond binary64 and no solver. Exceeded says the supplied error bound exceeds the tolerance, not that the true error does; it cannot be translated into a mathematical FAIL without a proved countercondition.
rows.accuracy_operations: Outward upper-bound composition, conservative tolerance assessment and bounded refinement/work accounting; explicit binary32-to-binary64 retry.
rows.cas_limits: A constructed expression is not a proof; a conditional witness retains its domain obligations. Exact symbolic construction supplies no general certified transcendental enclosure evaluator.
rows.cas_operations: Normalized arbitrary-precision rational carriers with budgeted exact arithmetic, sign and comparison; exact expression graphs and checked symbolic derivations with expected-judgment replay.
rows.distribution: It is in active development and is not published to crates.io.
rows.name: nrz
rows.scalar_limits: No arbitrary-precision enclosure format or general logarithm, exponential or noninteger-power enclosure API. Literal conversion can refuse on resource, domain or finite-range limits; its candidate is not an exact ledger carrier.
rows.scalar_operations: Finite admission; outward-enclosed addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, square and square root; exact negation and absolute value; bounded literal conversion into an enclosure. The corresponding binary32 types are also available.
rows.title: Naturrhythmuszentrum
